# Remaining ShinyDex area audit ledger

Created 2026-10-05 from current local files. Inventory only; full audit remains incomplete. No application code or existing audit/checkpoint files changed. External source links are references retained from current reports, not newly re-audited claims.

**386 confirmed remaining area records; 830 investigation candidates.** Counts are evidence units, not an exhaustive number of physical rooms.

## Count derivation and scope

- This is an inventory of currently documented unresolved scopes, not an exhaustive census of all game areas. No completion inferred from tests, hashes, normalized matches or report membership.
- BDSP decoded zone IDs often collapse multiple rooms into a base location. Missing independent floor/room mapping is explicitly labeled; Grand Underground decoded coverage cannot establish spawn progress/statue/room conditions. Duplicate base names with different IDs are intentional.
- ORAS binary types 0/6/7 do not supply full room, terrain, native/foreign or access mapping. Native reviewed terrain records and binary base records can overlap; they are separate evidence units, not disjoint physical rooms. Cross-version hideouts are excluded using reviewedExclusions; eight raw species candidates are not eight remaining areas.
- Older Sinnoh non-route wording is stale in part: radar_hunts.py now verifies named non-route exterior areas. These completed entries are excluded; Route 210 remains confirmed. Other non-route coverage beyond the reviewed exterior roster lacks an independently bounded unresolved inventory; cave walk tables are not invented Radar candidates.
- XY known ineligible cave/Friend Safari tables are excluded. Remaining named records are reconciliation candidates, not undone roster reviews. Full encounter-table/form comparison beyond the snapshot is missing.
- Alola SOS tables identify allies, not callers; location IDs do not establish precise rooms. Fourteen special-target notes are retained only for applicable species. No exhaustive caller/weather matrix is present.
- Older-generation roaming timing/prerequisites and other hunting-method coverage lack a bounded unresolved area inventory. They remain scope gaps; do not invent or count all historical release sites as confirmed unfinished areas.
- Region uses the game’s broad region, not an unsupported Alola island or room assignment. Earlier Unown CSV rooms retain raw area identifiers. Unmapped identifiers are evidence gaps, not invented names.
- Totals count unique game/version + region + inventory location + section/terrain evidence records, not species pairs or unique real-world maps. Confirmed means a report explicitly retains a check for the scope; candidate means location-specific remaining work needs investigation. Mixed records are counted once as confirmed.

## Named areas

Each record below matches its JSON ID. “Decoded” is inventory presence only. Reviewed details must be preserved while completing the precise remaining checks. JSON additionally retains exact slots/forms, reviewed guide terrain, and input hashes.

### Alola — Pokémon Moon

## Non-location work

### Events, gifts, HOME and GO

Historical dates/regions/redemption and campaign qualifications, GO shiny availability and global locks; retain completed HOME Manaphy/GO Keldeo and reviewed windows. Current individual reports take precedence over broad checkpoint wording.

References: audit/pending-event-review.json, audit/home-reward-review.json, audit/north-america-gift-review.json, audit/diancie-event-review.json, audit/scarlet-violet-event-review.json, audit/sword-shield-event-review.json

### Breeding, transfers and evolution

Exact parent acquisition/transfer prerequisites and evolution edge cases; Z-A Feebas Beauty-170 branch needs reproducible gameplay or implementation evidence.

References: audit/breeding-audit.json, audit/evolution-pending-audit.json, audit/evolution-review-evidence.json, audit/older-evolution-route-audit.json

### Poké Pelago

Four visitor rosters and story/recruitment gates reviewed; shiny odds, Charm interaction and reset behavior remain unverified. Island system mechanics are not counted as physical remaining areas.

References: audit/hunting-technique-review.json, pelago_hunts.py

### Browser/desktop and publication

Storage quota/download, NSIS installation/update/downgrade/restart/save persistence; UI/source links/attribution/comments/archive review and refreshed installer. Publication is outside this request.

References: audit/desktop-runtime-review.json, audit/runtime-qa.json, audit/desktop-qa.json, audit/REMAINING-AUDIT.md

Additional unenumerated scope: older-generation roaming release timing/prerequisites and other methods beyond inventories; see enumeration gaps.

## Maintenance

1. Read current reports and checkpoint; compare hashes for drift without treating hashes as correctness evidence.
2. Append version/patch and actual named inventory records with stable game/location/zone/terrain keys; label unsupported mappings as gaps.
3. Carry forward independently verified subchecks and their sources. Promote only the exact unresolved check supported by independent evidence; retire candidates with documented exclusions.
4. Recompute confirmed/candidate counts with the same evidence-unit key, keep non-location work separate, and record changed inputs. Do not reset whole areas or mark the full audit complete.

The machine-readable companion retains hashes of the current evidence inputs. Recheck their hashes before merging later audit results; another chat may update those files independently.
